description: Per-account v3 enrichment for telehealth ICP. Fields drive both the signal blender (business_model_exposure_weight) and the AE prioritization layer (employee_count_band, funding_stage, revenue_band, target_tier, state_count, topic_exposure). Watchlist directory fields (hq_city, hq_state, website, product_one_liner, founded_year) drive the dashboard's full-watchlist view. enrichment_status flags accounts where the new dimensions still need verification. disclosure_source flags whether risks come from a real 10-K (public) or industry-general analysis (private).
